sections.title: 3. Functional Topics Checklist
sections.note: These are everyday situations you should be able to handle at A1 level.

items.label: Introductions – greeting people, introducing yourself and others
Personal information – ask/answer about name, age, job, origin, address
Family – describe your family members
Daily routine – describe what you do every day
Shopping – ask for things, ask prices, try on clothes
Restaurant – order food and drinks, ask for the bill
Directions – ask for and give simple directions (go straight, turn left/right)
House – describe your home or apartment
Likes & dislikes – talk about hobbies, food, interests
Past events – talk about what you did yesterday or last weekend
Future plans – talk about what you are going to do next week
Weather – talk about the current weather
Health – say how you feel (illness, pain: I have a headache, I feel sick)
